name: Zodiac MyStamp Folder (Rat)+ Spring Decorative MyStamp Sheet (MYRATFDL)
page_name: Zodiac MyStamp Folder (Rat)+ Spring Decorative MyStamp Sheet (MYRATFDL)
description: Celebrate the year of the rat this CNY with SingPost. This commemorative A4 MyStamp folder features a traditional rat illustration, signifying wealth and good fortune, and explains the significance of each of the zodiac animals. There’s a MyStamp sheet inside the folder featuring a stamp tab for each of the 12 animals with a large decorative stamp tab depicting rats and lucky gold coins. An additional commemorative circular MyStamp sheet is also included, which shows a golden rat surrounded by spring flowers. Start your collection now and add to with a new zodiac animal MyStamp folder each Chinese New Year!
